The King’s Favourite

Having just added a setting for this tune please note that it is in McNulty’s in the key of Bb major.
The key of ‘C’ is more convenient for me to play on my B/C/C#, haven’t mastered Bb yet.
Of the ones here this is my favourite setting, obviously as I am biased. I play it fairly steadily, a slow jig.
Am now looking for one to put with it, either before or after. Any suggestions from anyone?
